title: Registrar says your account is on hold
scenario: An email says a registration hold will cancel your classes unless you verify identity today. It links to a page asking for your student login and a photo of your passport or driver’s licence.

answers.A: Ask your adviser or student services whether identity verification is required.
answers.B: Use the link because losing your classes would be a bigger risk than uploading ID.
answers.C: Open the registrar/student portal directly and check for a hold there; contact the registrar through a known channel if needed.

explanation: High-consequence academic threats make phishing powerful. A genuine hold should exist in the student system you already use.
proTip: If it can cancel your classes, it should appear in the real portal.
